metadata.loss_definition: sum over batch items of the mean absolute error of the 44.1 kHz waveform against the target
metadata.parameters: ten: eight material parameters plus pluck and pickup positions (fractions of L), batch perturbed by up to +-3 % each (BenchmarkMaterialBox)
metadata.memory_metric: NVML sampled process memory incl. context/reservations

baseline_rematerialisation.fdtd_ckpt: torch.utils.checkpoint (use_reentrant=False) over 256-step chunks of the spatial PyTorch loop
baseline_rematerialisation.fdtd_ckpt_reentrant: the same eager chunks with use_reentrant=True: each chunk first runs under no_grad and is re-run with its own backward pass
baseline_rematerialisation.diaz_44100_ckpt: upstream solve_tf recurrence as a nested jax.lax.scan with jax.checkpoint on each 256-step segment, full modal trajectory returned as upstream
baseline_rematerialisation.diaz_44100_ckptro: the same checkpointed recurrence with the pickup read inside the scan, so no modal trajectory is materialised
baseline_rematerialisation.fdtd_ckpt_compiled: torch.utils.checkpoint (use_reentrant=False) over 256-step chunks of compiled blocks
baseline_rematerialisation.fdtd_jax_ckpt: nested jax.lax.scan with jax.checkpoint on each 256-step segment, pickup read inside the scan
